craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of joined debate — Sāṅkhya fairly stated then page-turned. Proposal: think-Īśvara-change-trigger; (natva) printed kept per note. Rejected: (a) smoothing natva → killed printed. Read aloud: WARD-ing THE-in-ner-RANG-ers … LET-Ī-ŚVA-ra BE-thought CHANGE-trig-GER.

lines: Warding the inner rangers in root-nature, of secret kind —

reads_against.argmap: What is to be conceived? → Proposal: let Īśvara's change-causality be conceived for root-nature's rangers.
c1_essence: Sāṅkhya stated at full strength: pradhāna proved by presence, purposed by denying self-aims; change easy; only striving moves; nature faces down (vv19-22).
The page turns on admitted karma: where is His business? Let His triggering be conceived; seed imaged; Sāṅkhya godless; conditional close (vv23-27).
